scopeService: round robin world contexts within each lane; FIFO within one scope/lane
promotion: higher-priority subscriber promotes its queued shared job; no duplicate generation; promotion is sticky until dispatch
capacity: one bounded global queue; full queues reject without displacing accepted jobs
runningWork: never preempted; synchronous caller work and executor startup tasks bypass queued service
cancellation: explicit tokens complete their subscribers and remove abandoned queued work immediately; parent suppliers remain cooperative

cachePolicies.MEMORY_CACHE: automatic retention/reclamation within global engine budget; cacheBytes option ignored
cachePolicies.BOUNDED_MEMORY_CACHE: automatic local LRU bound and global pressure reclamation
cachePolicies.USER_MANAGED: retain only while local/global admission fits; no implicit eviction, including unpinned entries; explicit pin/unpin/evict/clear

globalReclamation: rotate starting context; reclaim local LRU automatic entries; preserve user-managed ownership and immutable client snapshots
